rules.description: Assign every bot exactly one primary MasterBot based on declared division/capability evidence.
Keep source repository, original path and prior division in routing metadata.
Link secondary MasterBots as collaborators; do not duplicate ownership.
DreamBenchmark evaluates capability evidence for every routed bot; failures create gap work.
DreamAgents and CommandCore coordinate cross-division tasks without becoming duplicate domain owners.
DreamQuality validates routing changes and blocks unsupported ownership claims.
Unclassified bots go to DreamDiscovery for capability classification before final ownership.
DreamResource tracks runtime/tool/data dependencies and capacity impact.
